mods.name: Rp Origins
mods.description: An Origins addon that replaces the default origins with new ones. (Requires Pehkui and Extra Origins)

releases.notes:
WOOOOO 4.0!!!! NEW ORIGINS ALERT!!!
I have just updated it and fixed bugs that i missed.
Warporoean's Warp not working
Void Origins dimension warp, returning not working.
Void origins end alliance not working.
Aquarian and Triton's aqua alliance not working.
All fixed ^^
Here's what's new:

Deep Origins category which will add 3 origins that "belong" underground. 
Deep Origins: Dwarfs, Crystallines, and Kraeiks


Void Origins category which will add 3 origins that "belong" in the end.
Void Origins: Wraiths, Draeiks, and Warporeans


Nerfed phoenix by making their reincarnation bar not regenerate upon fully dying. Water does less damage but still enough. Upon reincarnating Phoenix will regen faster so that the water damage doesn't constantly cause the phoenix to reincarnate. In order to replenish the reincarnation bar, you must consume a netherite ingot.


Revamped Tiefling. They will no longer be considered a "slow nether undead" type anymore. They are now considered an inferno spell-caster. Now equipped with 5 unique spells. See document for info.


Revamped nimbus to have a new trait that transforms them into a new origin, the sulfurus. Being in the nether triggers the transformation. Also nimbuses have 1 armor point and resistance 1 at all times and cannot deal damage in their cloud form. In sulfurus form they can only eat rotten flesh and exhaust SUPER quickly. Sulfuruses also have 1 extra heart than nimbuses and their armor and resitance double, and they can do damage in their ash form.


Revampe Aquarian. Made guardians passive to it, Rain Cloud's activation will be changed to sneak+hotbar-3, aquamancer health boost's activation will be changed to sneak+hotbar-4, the resource for it has been changed, it requires 80 water bar to activate, the cooldown for it has been lowered, it is active for way less time and recharges the bar a little slower BUT still faster than the other recharge options, speaking of other recharge options, the aquamancer bar now refills by being in rain/water or drinking potions, however, those do not regen it as fast as rain cloud. Aquamancer regeneration is now a group regeneration and gives regen to all entities in a radius of 4 blocks, also the regen lasts for 15 seconds instead of 30, and it costs 25 water bar instead of 40. The aquamancer strength spell now costs 65 water bar instead of 80. Aquarian will take double damage from fire. A new secret ability called RAIN SWIM, during rain (not including rain cloud) you have a bar that slowly fills up and when toggled on with primary you can swim through the rain, although it depletes the bar fairly quickly and you still take fall damage.


Patched crashes messing up scales.


Climbing ability, which is used by goblin and imp, togglable by sneaking and pressing hotbar-1


Solus's solar power storage recharge when in desired biomes buffed, and nerf their photosynthesis trait, but buff the saturation of the "energetic foods". Also their fireball solar spell was changed out with a solar arrow, which does withering II for 2 seconds and glowing for 5 seconds.


Triton has new secondary ability, guardians are passive to tritons, and patch them not being able to breathe in rain.


All spell casters, (tiefling, solus, draeik, warporean, and wraith), upon dying will only regenerate some of their "mana" back, instead of all.

And MUCH MORE!!

------------------------------------------------------------------------

And that's all for 4.0 (I hope I didn't miss anything!)

Along with those awesome new features and fixes I have made a few different versions of Rp Origins.

The default MOD one that requires extra origins (and pehkui ofc) and replaces the defaults with the Rp ones. (RpOrigins-4.0.jar)

The default DATAPACK one that requires extra origins and replaces the defaults with the Rp ones. (RpOrigins-4.0.zip)

One that doesn't require extra origins for my peeps that want to play this on forge. (RpOrigins-4.0-NoExtraOrigins.zip)


...

releases.notes:
HERE IT COMES! THE BIG THREE! 
RP ORIGINS 3.0 IS FINALLY HERE!
Here's what's new:

Solus's bug where you had to tame the invisible horse before being able to stay on it when using Solar Guardian, fixed!

Triton's Too Hot ability being buggy, fixed!
Triton's Strong Gills trait now increases faster than it decreases when in water, buffed!

Phoenix's Burning Fist ability burning for too long, nerfed!
Phoenix can no longer eat gunpowder, nerfed!
Phoenix take WAY more damage in water now, nerfed!

Elf's Druidcraft and Fae Magic ability being buggy, fixed!

Aquarian's Dehydrated/Summon Rain Cloud ability not working as intended, fixed!

Nimbus's Cloud Diet trait no longer feeds every second but now every 5 seconds, nerfed!

Harpy's Sharp Talons trait does more damage now, buffed!
Harpy now only has 5 flaps instead of 7, nerfed!

Goblin is now an impact 3, change!

Goblin's new ability:
Trap:
"Use your primary to construct a trap at your location. Only Goblins can see traps and are immune to them. Traps will last a full minecraft day before removing themselves. If you wish to remove them manually use your secondary key. If your trap bar is empty then you don't have a trap out. (Sneak to see the bar or put a trap out to see the bar)" 
Traps cause slowness and blindness when in it.

Harpy's new ability:
Divine Shield:
"Use your secondary to put up a divine shield. This shield lasts for 30 seconds, and while the shield is up you take reduced damage, no knockback, and give regeneration to all other PLAYERS around you. Once Divine Shield is done, you will be heavily slowed and weakened for 10 seconds."

------------------------------------------------------------------------

And that's all for 3.0 (I think, I probably missed something lol)

Along with those awesome new features and fixes I have made a few different versions of Rp Origins.

The mod one, which requires extra origins (and pehkui ofc) and replaces the defaults with the Rp ones. (RpOrigins-3.0.jar)

The normal one that requires extra origins and replaces the defaults with the Rp ones. (RpOrigins-3.0)

One that doesn't require extra origins for my peeps that want to play this on forge. (RpOrigins-3.0-NoExtraOrigins)

One that requires extra origins but doesn't replace the defaults with the Rp ones. (RpOrigins-3.0-NoReplaceDefaults)

And one that doesn't require extra origins AND doesn't replace the defaults. (RpOrigins-3.0-NoReplaceDefaultsAndNoExtraOrigins)

------------------------------------------------------------------------

I hope you have a wonderful time playing my pack! Be sure to give feedback!

Here's the document with some detailed info on how each origin work!

https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aMq53dsf7kOXx_VwJGmF2ElgI9JrNSBkYw2emYpFXv8/edit?usp=sharing
